name: mcp-confluence-file-based

tools.name: add_confluence_page_labels
tools.description: Idempotently add one or more global labels to an explicitly targeted Confluence page. Labels that are already present are left unchanged.

pageId.description: Numeric page ID. Takes precedence over pageUrl.

pageUrl.description: Supported same-origin Confluence page URL or path.

labels.description: One label name or a unique list of label names to add.

inputSchema.title: Add Confluence Page Labels Input
inputSchema.description: Arguments for idempotently adding labels. pageId takes precedence when both pageId and pageUrl are provided.

tools.name: create_confluence_page
tools.description:
Create a Confluence page under an explicitly targeted parent using storage XHTML read from a local bodyFile. Write `

` to bodyFile if you need to create an empty page.

parentPageId.description: Numeric parent page ID. Takes precedence over parentPageUrl.

parentPageUrl.description: Supported same-origin Confluence parent page URL or path.

bodyFile.description: Absolute path to a UTF-8 file containing Confluence storage XHTML.

inputSchema.title: Create Confluence Page Input
inputSchema.description: Arguments for creating a page from a local storage-XHTML file. parentPageId takes precedence when both parent references are provided.

tools.name: get_confluence_page
tools.description:
Fetch an explicitly targeted Confluence page, save its storage XHTML to a local bodyFile, and return page metadata without inline body content. The response never includes inline body content, so the chat context is not flooded with large XML; read bodyFile with your file tools. Do NOT split the file by byte or character length - you will cut XML tags and break the document. Search with Grep and extract whole blocks such as ..., ...
, or ....

pageId.description: Numeric page ID. Takes precedence over pageUrl.

pageUrl.description: Supported same-origin Confluence page URL or path.

inputSchema.title: Get Confluence Page Input
inputSchema.description: Required page reference arguments. pageId takes precedence over pageUrl when both are provided.

tools.name: list_confluence_child_pages
tools.description: List direct child pages of an explicitly targeted Confluence page with server-managed pagination and no inline body content.

pageId.description: Numeric parent page ID. Takes precedence over pageUrl.

pageUrl.description: Supported same-origin Confluence parent page URL or path.

pageSize.description: Confluence REST pagination batch size per request. This is not a cap on the total number of results; the overall result cap is controlled by server configuration (CONFLUENCE_MAX_TOTAL_PAGES).

inputSchema.title: List Confluence Child Pages Input
inputSchema.description: Arguments for listing direct child pages. A page reference is required; pageId takes precedence over pageUrl.

tools.name: list_confluence_page_attachments
tools.description: List metadata for up to 100 attachments on an explicitly targeted Confluence page without returning binary data or download URLs.

pageId.description: Numeric page ID. Takes precedence over pageUrl.

pageUrl.description: Supported same-origin Confluence page URL or path.

inputSchema.title: List Confluence Page Attachments Input
inputSchema.description: Required page reference arguments for listing attachment metadata. pageId takes precedence over pageUrl.

tools.name: list_confluence_page_labels
tools.description: List all labels currently attached to an explicitly targeted Confluence page.

pageId.description: Numeric page ID. Takes precedence over pageUrl.

pageUrl.description: Supported same-origin Confluence page URL or path.

inputSchema.title: List Confluence Page Labels Input
inputSchema.description: Required page reference arguments for listing labels. pageId takes precedence over pageUrl.

tools.name: list_confluence_pages
tools.description: List Confluence page or blog post metadata using server-built allowlisted CQL, an explicit spaceKey, at least one limiting filter, and server-managed pagination.

modifiedFrom.description: Inclusive lower bound for current last-modified time. Applied at minute precision (seconds truncated): the bound is converted to UTC and sent as a timezone-less CQL literal, which Confluence interprets in the Confluence account's timezone - when that timezone is not UTC the effective bound shifts by its UTC offset.

modifiedTo.description: Exclusive upper bound for current last-modified time. Applied at minute precision (seconds truncated): the bound is converted to UTC and sent as a timezone-less CQL literal, which Confluence interprets in the Confluence account's timezone - when that timezone is not UTC the effective bound shifts by its UTC offset.

createdFrom.description: Inclusive lower bound for creation time. Applied at minute precision (seconds truncated): the bound is converted to UTC and sent as a timezone-less CQL literal, which Confluence interprets in the Confluence account's timezone - when that timezone is not UTC the effective bound shifts by its UTC offset.

createdTo.description: Exclusive upper bound for creation time. Applied at minute precision (seconds truncated): the bound is converted to UTC and sent as a timezone-less CQL literal, which Confluence interprets in the Confluence account's timezone - when that timezone is not UTC the effective bound shifts by its UTC offset.

parentId.description: Numeric direct-parent ID. Mutually exclusive with ancestorId.

ancestorId.description: Numeric any-depth ancestor ID. Mutually exclusive with parentId.

pageSize.description: Confluence REST pagination batch size per request. This is not a cap on the total number of results; the overall result cap is controlled by server configuration (CONFLUENCE_MAX_TOTAL_PAGES).

inputSchema.title: List Confluence Pages Input
inputSchema.description: Structured allowlist filters for listing Confluence content without raw CQL.
inputSchema.$comment: The server additionally validates modifiedFrom < modifiedTo and createdFrom < createdTo whenever both values in a pair are present.

tools.name: move_confluence_page
tools.description: Move an explicitly targeted Confluence page under an explicitly targeted new parent after verifying expectedVersion, without changing the page body. Moving keeps the same page and therefore keeps its attachments.

pageId.description: Numeric page ID to move. Takes precedence over pageUrl.

pageUrl.description: Supported same-origin URL or path of the page to move.

newParentPageId.description: Numeric destination parent ID. Takes precedence over newParentPageUrl.

newParentPageUrl.description: Supported same-origin URL or path of the destination parent.

expectedVersion.description: Version that must still be current before the move.

inputSchema.title: Move Confluence Page Input
inputSchema.description: Arguments for moving a page with optimistic version checking. IDs take precedence over their corresponding URLs.

tools.name: remove_confluence_page_labels
tools.description: Idempotently remove one or more labels from an explicitly targeted Confluence page. Labels that are already absent are left unchanged.

pageId.description: Numeric page ID. Takes precedence over pageUrl.

pageUrl.description: Supported same-origin Confluence page URL or path.

labels.description: One label name or a unique list of label names to remove.

inputSchema.title: Remove Confluence Page Labels Input
inputSchema.description: Arguments for idempotently removing labels. A page reference is required; pageId takes precedence over pageUrl.

tools.name: update_confluence_page
tools.description: Replace the storage XHTML of an explicitly targeted Confluence page from a local bodyFile after verifying expectedVersion. If Confluence reports a different version at update time, the write is refused and a version-mismatch error is returned; the caller must stop and ask the user how to proceed instead of retrying blindly.

pageId.description: Numeric page ID. Takes precedence over pageUrl.

pageUrl.description: Supported same-origin Confluence page URL or path.

bodyFile.description: Absolute path to a UTF-8 file containing replacement Confluence storage XHTML.

expectedVersion.description: Version that must still be current before the update.

minorEdit.description: Whether to save the update as a minor edit.

versionComment.description: Message for the new Confluence version.

inputSchema.title: Update Confluence Page Input
inputSchema.description: Arguments for replacing page storage XHTML from a local file with optimistic version checking. A page reference is required; pageId takes precedence over pageUrl.

tools.name: upload_confluence_page_attachment
tools.description: Upload one local file to an explicitly targeted Confluence page and return attachment metadata without inline binary data or a download URL.

pageId.description: Numeric destination page ID. Takes precedence over pageUrl.

pageUrl.description: Supported same-origin Confluence page URL or path.

filePath.description: Absolute path to the local file to upload.

inputSchema.title: Upload Confluence Page Attachment Input
inputSchema.description: Arguments for uploading one local file. A destination page reference is required; pageId takes precedence over pageUrl.
